releases.body:
#### Features

- Adds `theme.tokens.dataviz.sequential.magma.series5`, `series6`, and `series7` color scales for heatmaps in light and dark themes. ([#126947](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126947))
- Updates `theme.tokens.syntax.ansi` colors to match Figma, including distinct cyan colors and revised light-mode yellows. ([#126948](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126948))

#### Fixes

- Fixes `@sentry/scraps/theme` imports throwing `process is not defined` in apps built with Vite or webpack 5. ([#127595](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127595))

#### Improvements

- Adds `Button`, `LinkButton`, `ButtonBar`, `InfoTip`, `InfoText`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Disclosure`, `SegmentedControl`, `Alert`, and generic badges to `@sentry/scraps`. ([#127639](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127639))
- Adds `Tooltip` and shared overlay helpers to `@sentry/scraps`, with support for server rendering without a document. ([#127630](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127630))
- Adds `Image`, `DescriptionList`, `Prose`, `Radio`, `StatusIndicator`, and `Hotkey` to `@sentry/scraps`. ([#127628](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127628))
- Adds `Link` and `Exter
- Publish Sentry's SVG icons as explicit subpath exports, with `IconDefaultsProvider` and `SvgIcon` for shared sizing and variants.

### New Features ✨

#### Aci

- Add issue short id to open periods response by @RudraPatel2003 in [#127441](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127441)
- Update backend to support fetching open periods across groups by @RudraPatel2003 in [#126786](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126786)

#### Ai

- Process LLM cache projects by @vgrozdanic in [#127026](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127026)
- Resolve LLM cache candidates by @vgrozdanic in [#127025](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127025)
- Build LLM cache shadow reports by @vgrozdanic in [#127024](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127024)
- Estimate LLM cache savings by @vgrozdanic in [#127023](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127023)
- Query LLM cache validation probes by @vgrozdanic in [#127022](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127022)
- Query LLM cache call sites by @vgrozdanic in [#127021](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127021)
- Parse LLM cache aggregates by @vgrozdanic in [#127018](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127018)
- Validate LLM cache findings by @vgrozdanic in [#127017](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127017)
- Classify LLM cache usage

aiSummary.oneLiner: Comprehensive error tracking, performance monitoring, and debugging platform for applications.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Sentry provides an end-to-end debugging platform that helps developers detect, trace, and fix application issues in real time. It captures unhandled exceptions, logs the exact stack traces, and correlates errors with performance bottlenecks. The system aggregates events intelligently to reduce noise and provides context regarding user actions that led to a crash. By offering cross-platform SDKs, it centralizes error monitoring across front-end, back-end, and mobile environments.
keyFeatures: Error Tracking: Automatically captures exceptions with detailed stack traces and environmental context.
Performance Monitoring: Traces slow API calls and database queries to identify application bottlenecks.
Release Tracking: Correlates errors with specific code deployments to quickly identify regressions.
Distributed Tracing: Follows requests across microservices to pinpoint exactly where failures occur.
Alerting Rules: Configures customizable notifications based on issue frequency or new error types.

useCases.title: Production Crash Reporting
useCases.description: Identify and fix unhandled exceptions that users encounter in live environments.

useCases.title: Performance Diagnostics
useCases.description: Monitor application latency and identify specific endpoints causing slow page loads.

useCases.title: Deployment Verification
useCases.description: Ensure new releases do not introduce a spike in error rates across the user base.

useCases.title: Frontend Debugging
useCases.description: Reconstruct user sessions using breadcrumbs to understand exactly what led to a UI crash.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Software engineers, DevOps teams, and engineering managers who need visibility into application health. It is suitable for both small startups and large enterprise teams managing complex microservice architectures.
